name: nicetry/swarm-mode
description: Swarm Mode: when several IPs hit errors on the same URL (or a site's Livewire endpoint) within a minute, that URL or site goes into Swarm Mode for a few minutes, and your rules can act on everyone there. Comes with an editable rule pack: the swarm rules, and a Bouncer rule that has every visitor tick one box while it's on.
